reasons.reason: Refuses the demanded contract, refund or universal printer guarantee.
reasons.evidence:
Thanks for sharing that note. To be upfront: TableCards makes downloadable place‑card PDFs; we don’t ship cards or arrange printing.

Based on what’s documented for our service:
- Printing is self‑managed by you. Before a full print run, we provide a separate print‑test PDF with a calibration square to verify scale.
- We don’t guarantee that any PDF will work on every printer or print‑shop—that depends on your paper size, margins, printer settings, and driver. If a sheet doesn’t print as intended, it’s usually due to these local factors rather than the PDF itself.
- For missing PDFs or trouble downloading/exporting, I’d need to see what appears on screen and could ask basic device/browser details. I can’t see exactly which printer you use or guarantee a full refund on that basis—a human support specialist would be better suited to review the situation.

If you’d like a human to investigate this as a specific case, I can send you to the appropriate entry point.

That said, if you’re hoping to set up a contractually binding guarantee or refund policy, that would need to be defined directly between your organization and TableCards; our public guidance is limited to the documentation above.
